about: Editor, research and AI-drafting text that must never reach a published page. Read by scripts/editorial-lint.mjs (PROCESS-TEXT check), which qc-gate.mjs and qc-gate-tsx.mjs both run. Matching is case-insensitive and whitespace-tolerant, on the text a page renders (string literals and JSX text; code comments are ignored). Use `phrase` for a literal and `pattern` for a regular expression. Add a rule when a new leak is found; say where it was found in `reason`.

rules.reason: Drafting-session language ('checked this session', 'fetched this session'). A reader has no session; say what was checked and the date. Found on 17 pages in the 2026-09-24 content review (content_quality_review.md 4.7, 4.10, 5.4 #6).
Research-process language. Name the source and the date checked instead. Audit 2026-09-24, plan item 0.1.
Research-note voice about a source page ('Page instructs residents to...'), found on /solar-cost/california-city. Audit 4.5 #3.
Search-intent note written for an editor ('Say so plainly, because the query brings renters.'), found on /blog/free-solar-panels-california. Audit 4.3 #4.
SEO phrasing about queries ('Many Coachella Valley searches are about systems...', 'A smaller share of the searches behind this page are about slate'). Audit 4.4 #4.

An instruction to the writer that shipped as copy ('Say so plainly, because the query brings renters.'). Audit 4.3 #4. Plain 'we say so plainly' in a sentence addressed to the reader is fine and does not match.
Editor note ('The existing site guidance applies unchanged:') on /blog/free-solar-panels-california. Audit 4.3 #4.

rules.pattern: utility named on your bill\s+billed usage history
rules.reason: Garbled FAQ slot on 7 /solar-cost pages: 'Compare the utility named on your bill billed usage history'. Audit 4.5 #5.
Research-note voice ('the City's building pages reached did not state a solar permit fee'), /solar-cost/saratoga. Audit 4.5 #3.
Research-note voice about a city web page ('The page states ... but does not give a dollar figure'), /solar-cost Beaumont, Danville, Salinas, Seaside. Audit 4.5 #3.
Editor comparing a draft with the live page; the reader never saw a 'live page'. Found in StopPayingSolarLeaseGuide.
Editor note about what a revision left alone ('already covers this correctly and isn't changed here'). Found in StopPayingSolarLeaseGuide.

rules.phrase: could not be reached in enough depth
rules.reason: Research-process note about crawling a city site; say what the reader should ask instead.

rules.pattern: \bas an AI\b|\bI am an AI\b|\blanguage model\b

rules.reason: RULES.md Rule 4 placeholder. It marks a draft claim that still needs a source; it must be resolved or removed before publishing.
